1. $ \ast $Saturdays falling on 25th July, 26th September and 28th November shall be Court sitting days.

2. **Saturdays falling on 4th July and 5th December have been kept as alternative Court sitting days in the event of declaration of any unforeseen holiday(s). The cases fixed on such unforeseen holiday(s) may be taken up on these days or as may be notified. However, the case(s) wherein orders/judgments are reserved shall be taken up on the next working day immediately following the date, which has been declared as additional holiday.

3. Holidays common to the High Court and Courts Subordinate to it have been shown in half red and half green squares and those shown in red squares will be observed exclusively by the High Court.

4. All Sundays and second Saturdays have been shown in red colour. Local holidays i.e. falling on $ 6^{\mathrm{th}} $ Mar, $ 2 2^{\mathrm{nd}} $ & $ 2 3^{\mathrm{rd}} $ Oct & $ 1 3^{\mathrm{th}} $ Nov, as shown in red squares, will be observed exclusively by the High Court. $ 2^{n d} $ Jan, $ 5^{n d} $ Mar, $ 2 1^{s t} $ Oct, $ 7^{n d}, $ $ 1 0^{n d} $ & $ 1 2^{n d} $ Nov will be observed as Local Holidays by the High Court as well as the Courts Subordinate to it.

5. The High Court will remain closed for Summer Vacation from Monday, 1 <sup>st</sup> June to Tuesday, 30 <sup>th</sup> June (both days inclusive) and for Winter Vacation from Saturday, 26 <sup>th</sup> December to Thursday, 31 <sup>st</sup> December (both days inclusive).

6. The Subordinate Courts (except the Courts of Judicial Magistrates First Class) in Delhi will remain closed for Summer Vacation from Monday, 15th June to Tuesday, $ 30^{\mathrm{th}} $ June (both days inclusive) and for Winter Vacation from Saturday, $ 26^{\mathrm{th}} $ December to Thursday, $ 31^{\mathrm{st}} $ December (both days inclusive).
